The '''Poviduze system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

==History==
Following the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Occupation of Bespin]], the system was prospected by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance's]] [[Ordnance and Supply/Legends|Ordnance and Supply]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] in order to discover a new source of [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] gas. No usable deposits were found.<ref name="WRoT">{{JournalCite|5|Wind Raiders of Taloraan}}</ref>
